scope: Starter catalogue for web UI, server-rendered websites and cross-platform mobile. Not exhaustive; verify functional claims from current official documentation when research tools are available.

web-ui.description: Interactive browser interfaces and internal dashboards; compare UI library/framework scope explicitly.

native-mobile.description: Cross-platform installed mobile apps. Clarify React versus React Native. Return fewer alternatives if the requested rendering/runtime constraints exclude other approaches.

hybrid-mobile.description: Installed mobile applications where web UI reuse and a hybrid runtime may be acceptable. These approaches differ and are not interchangeable libraries.

server-rendered-web.description: Websites requiring server rendering or prerendering. Compare application frameworks; do not silently substitute them for the underlying UI library.

technologies.name: React
technologies.selection_note: A UI foundation; compare a chosen app framework separately when routing or server rendering drives the decision.

technologies.name: Vue
technologies.selection_note: Web UI candidate; Nuxt is a separate application framework in the Vue ecosystem.

technologies.name: Angular
technologies.selection_note: Broader application framework scope than a standalone UI library; account for stack and team preferences.

technologies.name: Svelte
technologies.selection_note: Evaluate the UI framework separately from SvelteKit when application routing or server rendering is required.

technologies.name: Preact
technologies.selection_note: Consider when library footprint matters; verify React compatibility for the actual dependencies rather than assuming a drop-in replacement.

technologies.name: React Native
technologies.selection_note: Related to React but a distinct project/repository. Confirm this target when a user says React for native mobile.

technologies.name: Flutter
technologies.selection_note: A different language and rendering approach; compare for mobile delivery goals, not JavaScript library interchangeability.

technologies.name: NativeScript
technologies.role: Native platform framework with JavaScript/TypeScript runtimes
technologies.selection_note: Can use different UI framework integrations; identify the intended flavor and verify platform requirements.

technologies.name: Ionic Framework
technologies.role: Web UI toolkit for hybrid mobile and web applications
technologies.selection_note: Discuss the hybrid/native-runtime distinction and the need for a mobile runtime such as Capacitor; do not label it an equivalent native rendering engine.

technologies.name: Next.js
technologies.selection_note: Built on React; complementary to React itself. Compare against other application frameworks at this layer.

technologies.name: Nuxt
technologies.selection_note: Built on Vue; compare app-level rendering and deployment requirements rather than treating it as a standalone UI library.

technologies.name: SvelteKit
technologies.selection_note: Built on Svelte; an app-level candidate when routing, data loading or rendering requirements matter.

technologies.name: Astro
technologies.role: Web framework with an islands architecture
technologies.selection_note: Consider the content/interaction mix; can integrate UI components from other ecosystems and is not simply a React replacement.
